newsitem.title: USA: Columbus sees two wells adding to Q3, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Columbus sees two wells adding to Q3, 1997.

text.p: Columbus Energy Corp said Monday that two completed wells are expected to add to the daily production in its third quarter and for the rest of the 1997 fiscal year.

Columbus owns a 35 percent working interst in a natural gas discovery in Chambers County, Texas, the Syphrett Heirs No. 1. It was tested into the pipeline flowing at an initial daily rate of 4.6 million cubic feet of gas and 88 barrels of condensate.
In Roosevelt County, Montana, Columbus is a 90 percent owner of a oil discovery well, the McCabe No. 1, which had an initial test rate of 112 barrels of oil and two barrels of water a day.
It has since been placed on a pump and is producing between 114 and 141 barrels of oil daily.
